purpose: Declarative MCP tool contracts for model routing.

tools.name: registry_best
tools.description: Find the best component (local LLM, cloud LLM, skill) for a given task type. Use this to decide whether to handle a task locally or escalate to cloud.

task_type.description: Task type: layout_fix, log_filter, fact_extraction, code_generation, code_review, text_summarization, skill_tagging, relevance_scoring, memory_extraction, query_expansion, architecture

tools.name: registry_update
tools.description: Record a task outcome to update capability scores. Call after every LLM task to improve routing over time.

tools.name: registry_components
tools.description: List all registered components with their capability scores per task type.

tools.name: route_task
tools.description: Classify a task and get routing recommendation: which component to use (local LLM, cached skill, or cloud LLM). Use this before expensive cloud LLM calls to check if local can handle it. After executing, record outcome with track_task.

tools.name: track_task
tools.description: Record a task execution outcome to the performance tracker. Call after every LLM task to build accurate capability data. If the task was misrouted (wrong task_type), set corrected_task_type to teach the dispatcher.

corrected_task_type.description: Set if the task was misclassified — the actual task type that should have been routed. Ivanov's feedback to Uncle Petya.

tools.name: tracker_stats
tools.description: Get aggregate performance statistics: success rates and latencies per component+task_type.
